notes: The Classic raid essentials the raid view's composition block covers (docs/contracts/app-v1.md, RaidComposition.buffs): which class provides each, its client spell name, a short label the apps draw inside the tile while the icon is missing, and its icon. The data pipeline exports every icon named here (pipeline/icons.py raid_buff_icon_names), so the apps' /data/<build>/icons/<icon>.webp resolves. The API computes present and count from the classes signed In or Late. Blessings is Blessing of Might's icon: the live paladin trees do not grant Kings (curated/presets.json). The totems are the shaman's party buffs the class data and presets carry; Forever gives the Alliance shamans too (Dwarf Shaman).
